criterion: complete mathematical meaning plus source-proof-step correspondence; model-specific refinements explicitly labeled
kernel_score: preserved separately; no pending semantic annotation blocks kernel acceptance or existing publication
translation_score: independent assessment, bound to exact source, contract and formal artifact; kernel acceptance and automatic clause mappings are not semantic evidence
definition_tasks: review concepts, domains, constraints and representations; no invented existence/characterization obligation
proof_tasks: review statement and assumption fidelity, each source proof step, dependencies and any declared model refinement
alternative_proof: record goal fidelity separately; do not label a different proof route a faithful translation under this strict policy
unknown: unreviewed/uncertain is unknown; report review coverage and bounds rather than fabricate a final accuracy
contract_freezing: resolve interpretation decisions and approve the common contract before a prospective comparison
timing: independent semantic-review time and token usage are separate from solver and kernel time
judge_independence: evaluate each language against source and common contract, without seeing the other language output or the desired speed comparison
